meta.name: Suits LA
meta.description:
Ted Black, a former federal prosecutor from New York, has reinvented himself representing the most powerful clients in Los Angeles. But his firm is at a crisis point, and in order to survive, he must embrace a role he held in contempt his entire career.

Not complete. On your server: S1 8/13 (missing E5, E10-13)

videos.title: Seven Days a Week and Twice on Sunday
videos.overview: Attorney Ted Black and partner Stuart Lane are about to merge with a firm run by Ted's ex. Associates Rick and Erica vie for positions in the firm, but when the merger hits a snag, Ted, a former prosecutor, must step into a role he holds in contempt.

videos.title: Old Man Hanrahan
videos.overview: Ted needs Amanda's help with a new prosecutor in Lester's murder trial. Erica squares off against Rick to stop him from poaching a client. Stuart and Samantha argue over Rick's position.

videos.title: He Knew
videos.overview: Ted and Kevin deal with a bombshell about Lester's motive for killing his producing partner. Erica and Leah try to fulfill an unorthodox request for a celebrity client. In the past, Ted drags his old friend Stuart into his mob case.

videos.title: Batman Returns
videos.overview: Ted and Erica take on Samantha to save Lester's movie, but the battle may hurt his murder trial. Rick enlists Stuart's help when a difficult actor is arrested. In the past, the danger of going against a mob boss sends Ted to an old friend.

videos.title: Dester
videos.overview: Erica and Kevin keep a secret from Ted that could hinder his murder trial. With the case slipping away, Ted turns to an unlikely source to save Lester.

videos.title: Good Times
videos.overview: The death of a beloved client brings Ted and Rick back together. Kevin helps Erica with a family matter. Stuart and Samantha clash over a distasteful client. Leah considers leaving the law. In the past, Ted gets news that could derail his career as a prosecutor.

videos.title: Acapulco
videos.overview: In the past, Ted's mob trial case takes a bad turn, forcing him to turn to old friend Harvey Specter. Erica and Leah's clash over personal time gets the attention of the firm's new head of HR. Stuart calls in a favor from Rick to discredit a witness.

videos.title: Bat Signal
videos.overview: Ted and Harvey team up to right a wrong from their past and put a monster behind bars. Stuart confronts the possibility he may have unwittingly helped a client commit a crime.
